test_title: PYST 60: SSC GD Constable - Reasoning (Held On - 24 Feb, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question: Five friends Pooja, Bhawna, Charu, Geeta and Hema are sitting around a circular table facing towards the centre. Charu is not the immediate neighbour of Bhawna. Bhawna is second to the left of Hema. Geeta is the immediate neighbour of Bhawna and Hema. Who is sitting to the immediate left of Charu?
solution:
**Given:** Five friends Pooja, Bhawna, Charu, Geeta and Hema are sitting around a circular table facing towards the centre.

1) Bhawna is second to the left of Hema.

2) Geeta is the immediate neighbour of Bhawna and Hema. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9cc5a1eebaf27ef8b92b6c9bb9fd06870e445f2d56c7148e91cb0512eea68a9b.png] 

3) Charu is not the immediate neighbour of Bhawna.

After positioning Charu only one position is left which will be occupied by the only person left i.e. Pooja.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cfbef3d9cac0e591efe004efc6477c8ec6083a0567cfeee2e9584b8835664048.png] 

Thus, according to the final arrangement Hema is sitting to the immediate left of Charu.

Hence, **"Option 3"** is the correct answer.
